query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id) AS count FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala AS hp WHERE hp.snapshot = '2026-02-01' AND hp.person_type = 'Saudi' AND hp.age > 18 AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE AND NOT hp.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT bc.id FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala AS bc WHERE bc.person_type = 'مواطن' AND NOT bc.exit_timestamp IS NULL) LIMIT 1200
